name: Qaboojiyeyaasha dabka
intro: Madaxyada gridka ku yaal sida darajada khatarta, tuubada biyaha u keenta, iyo xisaabta haydroolikada. Shuruudaha naqshadeynta waa miisaankaaga; caddaymaha caadiga ah waa kuwa xirfadlaha ah ee dib u eegista. Caawin naqshadeed, ma aha ansixin.
